subject: CONVERT function
notes: LANDED 2026-08-09 (PB59 family 5b): the HEX legs hex THE SOURCE'S OWN BITS after r4's TRAILING zero-bit pad to a 16-bit multiple (one national character, D-N1) - implemented as the odd-byte-count zero append in the dstHex leg (byte-aligned reductions) plus the pre-packed BIT image (sub-byte ANY). The row's own repro now answers the rule: CONVERT(WS-A ANUM NAT HEX) = 4100 (corpus row AN; theory row), B"101" ANY NAT HEX = A000 (corpus row BN). The destination keyword picks only the DIGIT repertoire - the result is national-format digits with the 15.19.1 National category - never a re-encoding of the value (a same-day '0041' mis-derivation in the 5a landing text was corrected before this landing; DEVLOG 1277).
